parameters.voice_description: An original English-speaking mascot voice for Merc, an ageless liquid-metal adventure sprite who reads as a young adult. Androgynous with a light-mid register, warm rounded timbre, agile conversational pace, a ready smile and a small natural musical lift. Nimble, curious and companionable, with quick comic timing. Crisp natural articulation for short game dialogue. Dry, close-mic studio recording with excellent audio quality; no music, background sound or reverb. Moderate conversational volume, never shouting. A friendly encouraging coach: precise and playful, never childish, squeaky, shrill, nasal, announcer-like or imitative.
parameters.text:
A little note can break glass.

Hum a comfortable note.

Beautiful. A new path is open.

Gorgeous. Absolutely gorgeous.

You broke that with your voice. I need to sit down. I don't have legs.
